text:
alex: quick postmortem from staging: tenant A saw p99 jump when we drained their reserved nodes and immediately routed to CPU fallback.
tara: short version: binary fallback -> all traffic switched to cpu-backed variant -> tail latency exploded.
dim: can we do a pre-flight check? sample a small % to fallback and measure before a full switch.
yuki: yes. propose an "evaluation window" where operator routes 5% for 20s, collects p50/p95/p99 and error-rate, then decides.
alex: also add a packing-aware fallback_order so operator prefers gpu-small before cpu-only when slices exist.
tara: policy draft (params): sampling_rate=0.05, window_s=20, p99_mult_thresh=2.0, p50_mult_thresh=1.5, err_delta_thresh=0.005, ramp_steps=[20,60,100], fallback_order=[gpu-small,cpu].
dim: operator should emit metrics: fallback.eval.start, fallback.eval.p99_ratio, fallback.ramp.step, fallback.oscillation_count with tenant tag. console can read and let admins abort/promote.
yuki: add oscillation protection: if tenant toggles fallback >3 times within 60s, disable auto-promote and page ops.
ops-bot: incident INC-4527 opened for staging p99 regression.
alex: API sketch: POST /operator/v1/reservations/{id}/fallbacks {"policy":..., "mode":"start|abort|promote"} -> 202 eval_id. GET /operator/v1/evals/{id} -> status+metrics.
tara: RBAC: promote/abort only for platform-admin or tenant-admin. read-only can be broader.
dim: testing plan: unit tests for sampler, integration with fake packing, and a chaos run that causes drains.
yuki: edge-case: if gpu-small placement fails mid-ramp due to fragmentation, operator should skip to next fallback and emit placement_failure metric.
alex: tasks: TASK-501 (operator eval engine + metrics), TASK-502 (controller ramp wiring), TASK-503 (console UX + RBAC), TASK-504 (tests + chaos).
dim: I'll take TASK-501 and draft the proto by EOD.
tara: I'll take TASK-502 & TASK-504 integration work.
yuki: console + alerts are mine.
alex: thanks all. I'll add a short note to the autoscale RFC follow-up and link INC-4527.
ops-bot: tasks created: TASK-501,TASK-502,TASK-503,TASK-504
